content:
The audit report generation failed due to incorrect handling of null values in the 'RawData' and 'Formatted Data' sheets.
The verifier failed with an AssertionError in test_outputs.py because the generated Excel sheets contained None instead of the expected 'N/A' string. Specifically, at index 5 of the data rows, the actual value [None] did not match the expected ['N/A']. This discrepancy caused failures in both test_rawdata_copies_source_exactly and test_formatted_data_logic within the pytest suite.
